engagement_background.objective: CJ Pony Parts engaged Treya Partners to drive measurable procurement cost reductions through strategic sourcing, with explicit targets of identifying at least $100K in annual savings by September 2021 and delivering $330K–$660K in recurring annual savings by November 2021.
engagement_background.scope_summary: The project covers nine priority spend categories—Quick-hit GPO items, Fasteners, Small Parcel, Packaging & Shipping Supplies, LTL/FTL, Employee Benefits, Temporary Labor, P-Card, and Ocean Freight—representing roughly $11.5 million in baseline spend drawn from a total external vendor spend of ~$103 million. Direct product COGS outside the named categories and any parallel sourcing efforts are excluded.
constraints_challenges: Aggressive timeline: savings of $100K needed within three months and full sourcing activities completed in five months.
Client must halt any ‘parallel’ procurement activities to prevent market confusion, limiting flexibility during the engagement.
Data gaps: P-card and T&E details not captured in AP extract; additional cleanup required for vendor naming and categorization.
Limited client bandwidth—timely stakeholder input and data provision are critical and identified as a risk.
Multi-site footprint (Harrisburg, PA and Las Vegas, NV) complicates supplier transitions, e.g., implementing multi-carrier LTL solutions.
IT integration challenges for LTL solution (catalog classification, API work estimated at 3–4 months).
Strong incumbent relationships (e.g., 95 % FedEx share in parcel) reduce ‘credible switching threat’ in some categories.

procurement_environment.data_availability: 12-month AP spend file, shipment-level parcel data, and key carrier contracts (FedEx, UPS, USPS, UPS Freight) are available; no single contract repository identified.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: Spend file missing P-card/T&E components; multiple vendor naming conventions and incomplete categorization require cleanup before analysis.
